parsed.rationale: All four records are `type-alias-object` declarations with empty `fields_or_signature` lists, meaning they share only the structural shape of being a zero-field type alias — not any actual content or domain meaning. `ApplicationWillTerminateMessage` (Core package), `PlaybackStalledMessage` and `HLSPlaybackStalledMessage` (Playback package), and `RequestSentMessage` (MusicShareKit package) each represent distinct domain events in unrelated subsystems. The `shared_field_count: 1` with `jaccard: null` and `differing_slots: null` confirms the only commonality is the empty-body shape, not any shared fields or logic. Collapsing these into a single type or common base would conflate unrelated domain concepts and destroy the semantic clarity that distinct message types provide in a message-passing architecture.
